step keys move one row in pager mode, where the scroll box holds focus
step keys still move one row after a click in the review stream
clicking and dragging the live scrollbar scrolls the review pane
mouse wheel scrolling preserves the divider and header handoff in a real PTY
mouse wheel scrolling moves the review pane

adaptations: Ratatui TestBackend drives the live renderer at each source terminal size. Synthetic clock spacing makes wheel steps deterministic.
The header handoff test visits each exact separator/header boundary and verifies stable viewport height and file-name counts.
The two collapsed-gap cases are combined in one down/up round-trip test.
Scrollbar interactions use the renderer's measured track and thumb hit rectangles instead of probing backend-dependent edge columns.
Code-click coverage uses a visible changed code row in a working-tree comparison; CLI show and stdin parsing are validated separately.
